mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET state='agent_running' WHERE id=#{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM drafts d WHERE d.message_id=#{messageId} AND (d.state IN ('approved','sending','sent','send_failed','send_unknown') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM send_commands sc WHERE sc.draft_id=d.id))
SELECT id FROM agent_runs WHERE message_id=#{messageId} AND conversation_revision=#{revision} AND state IN ('queued','running')

SELECT m.id FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.direction='inbound' AND m.message_type NOT IN ('system_hint','order_info') AND NOT ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT payload FROM product_details WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND goods_id=#{goods}
mapper.update: UPDATE drafts SET state='outdated' WHERE message_id=#{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot FROM knowledge_versions WHERE id=#{knowledgeVersion} AND shop_id=#{shopId}
SELECT mode FROM shops WHERE id=#{shopId}

SELECT id,direction,content,message_type FROM (SELECT m.id,m.direction,m.content,m.message_type,m.created_at FROM messages m WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.created_at<=#{before} AND m.message_type<>'system_hint' AND NOT AND (m.direction='inbound' OR (m.direction='outbound' AND m.state='sent')) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 20) recent ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT id,media_json,message_type,content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND created_at<=#{timestamp} AND (media_json IS NOT NULL OR (message_type='order_info' AND direction='inbound')) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT id,content,message_type FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND created_at<=#{timestamp} AND direction='inbound' AND (message_type='order_info' OR (message_type='text' AND content LIKE '%-%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT id,media_json FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND direction='inbound' AND message_type IN ('system_hint','goods_inquiry') AND created_at<=#{cutoff} AND media_json IS NOT NULL AND related_platform_message_id=#{platformId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runs SET state='completed',result=#{payloadJson} WHERE id=#{runId}
UPDATE agent_runs SET state='superseded' WHERE id=#{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM drafts WHERE message_id=#{messageId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET state='waiting_human' WHERE id=#{messageId}
UPDATE drafts SET product_cards=#{cards},cards_edited=FALSE WHERE id=#{draft}
